_meta.purpose: Nano banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image via fal.ai) prompts for labeled-diagram images to power photo-diagram hotspot skills across Grade 7's built subjects (Math, Science, Social Studies, Pre-Technical, Agriculture & Nutrition, Creative Arts and Sports, English, Kiswahili, Mandarin). Every image and its full part list is sourced directly from the official KICD Grade 7 design PDFs in designs-grade-7/, per curriculum-reference/CURRICULUM-MINING-GUIDE.md (every enumerated item the design names is included — nothing sampled down) and curriculum-reference/RIGOR-STANDARDS.md. CRE, IRE, HRE, French, German, Arabic, and Indigenous Language have no photo-diagram-worthy content identified yet (their Grade 7 skills are built, but nothing reviewed so far in those subjects has the same kind of nameable-visual-parts content that justifies a labeled photo).

howToUse: 1. Copy one entry's `prompt` field verbatim into fal.ai (nano banana / Gemini 2.5 Flash Image).
2. Save the returned image, then tell Claude which `id` it corresponds to and where the file was saved.

3. Claude will inspect the image with vision to confirm every letter actually printed on the image matches an item in that entry's `expectedLabels`, note (and skip, not guess) any duplicated/ambiguous printed letters, run `npm run images:webp` (from web/) to convert the source PNG to WebP in place, add/reuse an entry in the shared cross-skill registry `web/src/lib/photoImages.ts` (never inline the image/part data directly in a skill file), wire a multi-Bloom's-tier set of question branches into the skill file(s) named in `targetSkillFile` per RIGOR-STANDARDS.md, and verify (tsc + lint + a real request against the running dev server) before calling it done.

4. If any part is missing an arrow/letter, or a letter's arrow lands on the wrong structure, regenerate with a corrected prompt (add an explicit correction line naming the missing/misplaced part) rather than accepting a partial image — every part in `expectedLabels` must be identifiable.

5. An image is not tied to the one skill in `targetSkillFile` — once registered in photoImages.ts, reuse it from any other skill (same or different subject, same grade) that has a genuine curriculum reason to reference it, per curriculum-reference/CURRICULUM-MINING-GUIDE.md's photo-diagram section.
_meta.styleGuideSummary: All prompts embed the same style block so every generated image reads as one consistent visual system across the whole app — do not vary the style between images.
_meta.criticalRule: Every prompt instructs nano banana NOT to print any part's name as text anywhere on the image — only a circled capital letter + thin leader line per part. This is deliberate and different from typical stock 'labeled diagram' images (which usually print full text labels): text labels would give the answer away before the question is even asked. If a returned image has any part's name printed as text, it must be regenerated.
_meta.cautionFlag: One entry (pretech-g7-kenyan-currency) involves depicting Kenyan currency. Flagged with a caution field — read it before generating that one specifically.
